note: Part 10: doors you can read from any side. Every door (DOOR, OPEN_DOOR, LOCKED_DOOR, a found SECRET_DOOR, BARRICADE) is a threshold, a frame, a leaf and its light, and a locked one a padlock and a plaque; the boss floor's exit (LOCKED_EXIT) a grate. Sizes in cells (16 px a cell); pictures are rects [x, y, w, h] in pixels of the region's sheet. packages/client/src/r3d/doorkit.ts builds the quads.

sheets.filter: nearest, no mipmaps; the glow sheet is an emissive map (black where nothing glows)

sewers.materials: dark oak leaf with a slot window (PD's), tarred timber frame, worn stone sill

prison.materials: PD's arched oak leaf, dark iron frame, iron and stone sill

caves.materials: rough planks with a Z brace, pale pine pit-props, plank sill

city.materials: blue-grey steel with amber slits (PD's), brass frame, slate sill with brass lips

halls.materials: black iron with green runes (PD's), bone frame, obsidian sill

heights.note: a frame is a pixel proud of its wall (cut walls: 0.95, their frame 1.0); shoulder: the wall cell south of a door in a north-south wall

post.note: two posts lining the doorway, a cell deep, from the floor to frameTop

lintel.note: two beams across the doorway's faces, under frameTop

leaf.hinge: the inner edge of a post, in the wall line (z 0.5)

swing.note: as doorswing.ts: into the room on the camera's side if it can

threshold.note: 0.125 of lip out into each room

padlock.note: on both faces of a locked leaf, at x (centre) and y (share of the leaf's height)

plaque.note: on both lintels of a locked or vault door, a pixel over the frame

secret.note: crack0-2 over the wall (top, and the south face of an east-west wall), sparks at stage 2, the wall sinks into the floor, then the door

key.note: doors-fx key: to the lock, in, turned, a spark; then the padlock drops and the chain slides off

DOOR.light: warm if the cell beyond is lit, else none

vault.note: a LOCKED_DOOR of a vault room, if the level says which (else the locked look)

SECRET_DOOR.note: the wall, exactly as the original; when found: the cracks, sparks, the wall sinks, then DOOR

BARRICADE.burning: flames (doors-fx) over it, the glow of the boards
BARRICADE.burnt: charred, then gone (the cell is floor)

faces.post: S/N: post_face (postcut_face), E/W: post_side (postcut_side), T: post_top
faces.threshold: T: threshold_plain|locked|vault (12 x 20: across x along the way through), sides: threshold_side
faces.leaf: S: leaf_<look> (leafcut_<look>), N: the same mirrored, T: top_<look>, E/W: edge (edgecut)
faces.padlock: S/N: padlock, T: padlock_top, E/W: padlock_side
faces.light: strip_<c> under the leaf and transom_<c> over it (added), spill_<c> on the threshold (added)
faces.grate: T: grate (holes cut out), sides: grate_side
faces.crack: T: crackcap<n>, S: crack<n> (24 px = a whole wall)
